page_title: NAN 1-2 MAR | Nantes v Marseille 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+8' The game is interrupted as Moses Simon (Nantes) is flagged offside.
90+7' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+3' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
87' Derek Cornelius is substituted due to injury. Roberto De Zerbi gives a chance to Valentin Rongier (Marseille).
85' Derek Cornelius (Marseille) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

83' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the right post. A few inches to the left and it could have been a sweet goal!
82' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
81' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Antoine Kombouare prepares a substitution. Tino Kadewere is replaced by Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Douglas Augusto trots off the pitch and is replaced by Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes).
78' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
77' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
74' Matthis Abline (Nantes) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
70' Antoine Kombouare has decided to substitute Marcus Coco and he is replaced by Kelvin Amian (Nantes).
69' Today's match ends for Jonathan Rowe who will be replaced by Lilian Brassier (Marseille).
69' Pol Lirola is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Derek Cornelius (Marseille).
68' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matthis Abline (Nantes) replacing Mostafa Mohamed.
68' Substitution. Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) replaces Sorba Thomas.
67' A shot from the edge of the box by Tino Kadewere (Nantes) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second.
66' 6:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
64' Geronimo Rulli pulls off a great save to deny Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net.
61' 1 - 2 What a beauty from just outside the box! Mason Greenwood (Marseille) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
59' Here is a change. Quentin Merlin is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Michael Murillo (Marseille).
59' Substitution. Ismael Kone makes his way off the pitch and Luis Henrique (Marseille) comes on as his replacement.
58' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Alban Lafont makes a comfortable save.
54' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
52' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
51' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for an infringement.
50' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
50' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) is about to take a corner kick.
49' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marcus Coco (Nantes), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. It will be a corner kick for Nantes.
47' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45+3' Marcus Coco (Nantes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
42' The corner from Quentin Merlin (Marseille) is intercepted by Alban Lafont.
41' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee signals a corner kick to Marseille.
39' 1 - 1 Tino Kadewere (Nantes) converts a killer cross with a precise low shot that goes into the bottom left corner. What a brilliant finish!
37' The Marseille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

35' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the roof of the net. It's a great effort but an even better save from Geronimo Rulli, who tips the ball over the bar.
35' Flag goes up against Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
33' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) is penalised for holding. Bastien Dechepy signals a set piece.
29' A dangerous looking corner kick from Quentin Merlin (Marseille) is cleared to safety by the defence.
28' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
26' The percentage of ball possession is – 19:81.
24' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Jonathan Rowe plays it into the box, and Neal Maupay (Marseille) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 0:1.
23' The move breaks down when Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post.
22' The referee blows his whistle as Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) was too aggressive in his challenge.
21' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but Geronimo Rulli comes off his line to gather the ball.
18' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alban Lafont is well positioned and punches the ball away.
18' Neal Maupay (Marseille) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
18' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Quentin Merlin (Marseille) takes it short.

17' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Marseille.
15' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Alban Lafont.
10' Moses Simon (Nantes) commits a foul and Bastien Dechepy immediately signals a free kick.
7' The resulting corner from Quentin Merlin (Marseille) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

7' Great solo effort by Mason Greenwood (Marseille) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Marseille.
5' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Bastien Dechepy saw the whole situation.
3' Neat passing move from Marseille in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
Nantes will kick-off.
